no-reader:topic.title: Nobody reads Order events
no-reader:topic.message: Checkout publishes to Order events, but nothing consumes it: it keeps every message, unread.
no-reader:topic.rationale: A topic keeps what's published until its retention ends, whether anything reads it or not. With no consumer group, nothing acts on its messages, and more partitions don't change that.

fix.label: Add a consumer…
fix.choice: Pick what reads Order events, then add it and connect topic to it.
